findings.F1: The test's main measure is on the side the idea predicts (unusual 5-day move in the short direction +0.84 %, t 2.18, 753 days), but it is not graded: the deeper half minus the shallower half is -0.16 %, and the test already used all four folds and all 19 coins, so no more data is available to the idea.
findings.F2: Rebuilt on folds B and C, the cases pool to +0.86 % over 5 days (t 1.44 with one day's cases taken together, 529 cases on 280 days), and across the five forecast quintiles the move is flat at +0.62 %, +0.96 %, +1.02 %, +0.94 % and +0.74 %, so overall a deeper stretch brings no larger fall.
findings.F3: The effect sits in the falling trend. Cases with a 60-day return below -10 % fall an unusual +3.24 % over 5 days (t 4.52, 148 cases). Choppy cases give +2.01 % (t 1.82, 75 cases) and rising cases +0.49 % (t 0.32, 51 cases).
findings.F4: Only inside the falling trend is the move graded the way the idea says: the deeper half gives +3.96 % against +1.77 % for the shallower half (99 and 49 cases). In the choppy trend the deeper half is lower (+1.73 % against +2.30 %), and the rising trend has too few cases to read (21 and 30, with the shallow half at -0.77 %).
findings.F5: The effect is not steady across periods, so it is partly drowned by the market's own phases. It shows in 2018 (+2.77 %, t 2.60) and 2019 (+2.00 %, t 3.28) and turns over in 2020 (-1.78 %, t -2.01), and its correlation with the forecast's size is weak even in the falling trend (0.095).
findings.F6: A longer horizon does not clear it up: over 10 days the pooled move is +1.29 % with a day-clustered t of 1.45, no stronger than over 5 days (t 1.44).

ideas.idea: In a falling, calm market, the further a coin's close sits below its 20-day average, measured in units of the standard deviation of its daily returns over the same 20 days, the more it keeps falling, over the next 5 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader would short deep stretches below the average in a calm market only while the coin has been falling over the past two months, and would size the short larger the deeper the stretch.
ideas.name: falling calm stretch keeps falling
